항목.프롬프트: Repaint exactly the same picture with exactly the same roads, houses, temple, river, hills, camps and colors, changing only the city wall: the whole ring of the city wall is now completely rebuilt, a tall thick wall of fresh cut tan stone blocks with crenellations all the way around, with square towers, and every gateway is rebuilt as a tall stone gatehouse with new wooden doors standing open; the three gaps where the roads cross the wall are closed by new stone wall; no rubble left. Nothing covers the roads outside the wall. No characters, no people, no text. All houses are one-story or two-story stone and mud-brick houses with flat earthen rooftops and low parapets; no sloped roofs, no roof tiles, no red tiles. No statues, no idols, no carved figures, no winged discs, no crescent shapes, no moon ornaments, no religious symbols anywhere.
